sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Portable Phased-Array Medical Diagnostic Scanners

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid — statutory common law substantially derived from the United States (Business Corporations Act modeled on the Delaware General Corporation Law), with customary law governing land tenure matters
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association with the United States (1986, as amended 2003)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2012 (as amended); Business Corporations Act, MIRC Title 51 (as amended); Beneficial Ownership Regulations issued by the Registrar of Corporations; FIU Guidance Notes and the RMI National Risk Assessment

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of valid passport (and national ID where applicable) of each director, shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — notarization followed by certification of the issuing competent authority and final legalization by the Embassy of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (Washington, D.C.); the Republic is not a member of the Hague Apostille Convention

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency or corporate register extract of any corporate shareholder evidencing the direct ownership chain to natural persons
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or registered agent of the parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — same chain as above (competent authority certification plus RMI Embassy legalization)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original bank reference letter for the intended transacting accounts
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — bank officer notarization plus competent authority certification and RMI Embassy legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement dated within the last 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — notarization plus RMI Embassy legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Signed UBO declaration and personal information form (licensed RMI registered agent standard KYC form)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — notarized signature verification plus RMI Embassy legalization

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory real-time screening of all directors, shareholders, UBOs, authorized signatories and material counterparties against the UNSC Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, HM Treasury Consolidated List, EU consolidated sanctions list and RMI FIU domestic designations; identification of a PEP triggers enhanced due diligence, source-of-funds documentation and senior management approval per the AML Act 2012 and FIU guidance; annual refresher screening is required; the entity is treated as Low_Risk_Standard tier for AML onboarding.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Commerce, Majuro — Republic of the Marshall Islands Corporation Registry; name clearance filings are effected exclusively through licensed resident registered agents with no public direct-access portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be composed of Latin (English) script characters only; non-Latin names must be transliterated into English; the proposed name must be distinguishable from names on the Corporation Registry index and must not misrepresent the corporation's purpose or the nature of its business
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant's licensed registered agent may (1) refile with a modified and distinguishable name; or (2) file a written request for administrative reconsideration with the Registrar within 14 days of the rejection notice, citing comparable accepted names; and (3) if still denied, petition the High Court of the Marshall Islands for judicial review of the Registrar's decision; a pending name reservation may be renewed before expiry at the Registrar's discretion upon payment of the reservation fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted — every Business Corporation must maintain a physical registered office at the address of a licensed registered agent in Majuro; PO boxes or virtual-only addresses do not satisfy the Business Corporations Act
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low — approximately 3%–5% annual probability for a non-resident, export-dedicated manufacturing entity with no domestic physical assets; inspection triggers are typically limited to AML complaints, sanctions hits or deficiencies in required filings.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and reservation fee (single name, initial 30-day reservation)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee schedule under MIRC Title 51; prevailing market tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificate of Incorporation filing fee (non-resident Business Corporation, up to 500 authorized shares)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory incorporation fee per Business Corporations Act schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent and registered office services (first annual term)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for non-resident BC annual agent and office service

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT UBO identification and onboarding file (KYC, PEP and sanctions screening)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed registered agent / compliance service provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate for low-risk standard tier corporate onboarding

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and consular legalization bundle (5 documents: passport, address proof, bank reference, incumbency, UBO declaration)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary Public, issuing competent authority, and Embassy of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (Washington, D.C.)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial tariff plus prevailing diplomatic authentication fee benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: International courier and expedited document delivery (origin to Majuro and return)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act 1990, as amended, codified at Title 27 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code (MIRC), particularly Sections 27-101 (incorporation), 27-103 (corporate name), 27-121 (execution and filing of Articles), 27-602 (registered office and registered agent), 27-801 (board of directors), and 27-805 (officers).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands, Majuro Atoll.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Form BC-1) filed under the Business Corporations Act; Certificate of Incorporation issued by the Registrar of Corporations.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is required for a non-resident Business Corporation under the Business Corporations Act 1990. The Corporation may commence business upon the subscription of one or more shares as stated in the Articles; a paid-up capital escrow account is not mandated by Marshall Islands law.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the incorporation of the Corporation under the Business Corporations Act of the Republic of the Marshall Islands is hereby ratified and confirmed. RESOLVED, that the subscription of shares by the initial subscribers is accepted, and the Secretary is directed to issue share certificates and maintain the share ledger. RESOLVED, that the registered office at the address of the Corporation's registered agent in Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands, is adopted as the principal statutory office. RESOLVED, that the President, Secretary, and Treasurer are appointed officers, to serve until replaced by the Board. RESOLVED, that the officers are authorized to execute banking documents, license applications, and permits necessary for the Corporation's medical device manufacturing and export operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Availability Search and Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Finance, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name clearance request listing up to three proposed corporate names indicating the desired corporate name ending. Pay the name reservation fee and obtain a Name Reservation Certificate, valid for 120 days, before filing the Articles of Incorporation. Ensure the proposed name does not conflict with any registered entity name or protected trademark in the Marshall Islands registry.
required_dossiers: Name search and reservation fee receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected due to a conflict, file a revised request with alternate names and re-pay the reservation fee; no statutory cure period attaches, but priority is preserved by the original submission date if a supplemental request is filed within five business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent in the Marshall Islands, with notarization by a Marshall Islands Notary Public or Commissioner of Oaths
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation setting forth the corporate name, the specific purpose of manufacturing and exporting color Doppler ultrasound consoles and other medical diagnostic devices, the class and number of authorized shares, the name and address of the registered agent, the registered office address, and the name and signature of the incorporator. Execute the Articles before a notary public and obtain the written acceptance of the registered agent.
required_dossiers: Written consent and acceptance of registered agent
Copy of the Name Reservation Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar queries drafting defects, execute corrected Articles by a supplemental filing and resubmit; notarization defects are cured by re-execution before a duly licensed notary within ten business days of the query.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing of Articles and Payment of Incorporation Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed Articles of Incorporation, together with the registered agent acceptance and the statutory filing fee, with the Office of the Registrar of Corporations. Select ordinary or expedited processing. The Registrar conducts a compliance review under Title 27 MIRC and, upon satisfaction, will proceed to issue the Certificate of Incorporation.
required_dossiers: Original and conformed copies of the Articles of Incorporation
Government fee payment voucher or wire transfer confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is rejected or queried, file a curative amendment or a resubmission within 30 days of the notice; pay any deficiency fee and obtain a written waiver or clearance from the Registrar before re-filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Corporate Kit Preparation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Finance, and the appointed Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation. The registered agent then prepares the corporate kit comprising corporate bylaws, share certificate book, corporate seal, minute book, share register, and registered agent confirmation. Verify that the Certificate of Incorporation accurately reflects the corporate name, registered agent, and date of formation.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation issued by the Registrar
Registered agent corporate kit order form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Incorporation contains clerical errors, apply for a Certificate of Correction supported by an officer's affidavit; pay the statutory correction fee and obtain the corrected certificate within 15 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Records, Officer Registration, and First Board Resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations and the appointed Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the initial director and officer register with the registered agent and complete the organizational formalities by adopting the first board resolution either at an organizational meeting or by unanimous written consent. Ensure the registered agent's acceptance and registered office confirmation are deposited in the corporate minute book. This step completes the statutory corporate governance foundation for subsequent licensing applications.
required_dossiers: First board resolution or unanimous written consent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the annual reporting details or officer register are not filed timely, late fees accrue; cure by filing late returns with the Registrar and paying the reinstatement or late filing penalty before undertaking any regulated business activities.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Business License Office, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands, in coordination with the Ministry of Health and Human Services for medical device manufacturing authorization and import/export permits.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business License with Manufacturing Endorsement for Medical Diagnostic Equipment, issued under the Business License Act 2009.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority (EPA), Republic of the Marshall Islands
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: EIA Registration / Initial Environmental Examination (Category B screening threshold). A full EIA Report is mandated only if annual production capacity, wastewater discharge volume, or hazardous waste generation exceeds the screening thresholds prescribed in the EPA Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Industrial wastewater must meet EPA discharge limits: pH 6.0-9.0, BOD5 not exceeding 50 mg/L, TSS not exceeding 50 mg/L, oil and grease not exceeding 15 mg/L, and no visible sheen. Workplace VOC exposure for cleaning solvents and adhesives must comply with ACGIH TLV and OSHA permissible exposure limits. Electronic scrap, spent calibration reagents, and cleaning solvents must be managed under EPA hazardous waste manifest requirements and Basel Convention-compliant transboundary movement procedures for export disposal.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Majuro Fire and Rescue Services confirming compliance with NFPA 101 Life Safety Code and NFPA 10 portable fire extinguisher requirements; structural load inspection certificate issued by the Majuro Atoll Local Government building authority for the leased manufacturing premises; and workplace clearance from the occupational safety authority confirming compliance with electrical safety (IEC 60601-1), cleanroom, and ergonomic workstation requirements for medical device assembly operations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Revenue and Customs Administration (RICA) of the Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands; official tax portal: https://www.mirevenue.org
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Non-resident Business Corporations (MH_BC) are exempt from RMI income tax and are not required to obtain a domestic TIN or VAT ID. The company obtains its Marshall Islands Corporate Registration Number from the Registrar of Corporations at formation, which is used for the filing of annual franchise tax reports. If a tax identification number is required by an overseas regulator or counterparty, the company may apply on a voluntary basis to RICA for a Non-Resident Identification Number (NRID) using Form RTD-TIN-01 and a certificate of good standing; however, no recurring income tax filing obligation attaches to such an NRID.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No RMI domestic check-the-box, anti-hybrid, or other tax classification election is available; a non-resident business corporation is automatically treated as a tax-exempt foreign entity under RMI law. For U.S. federal income tax purposes, the entity may be separately classified under U.S. Treasury Regulations Section 301.7701-3 (e.g., a single-owner RMI BC may elect to be treated as a disregarded entity), but this election has no domestic RMI effect.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No national VAT, GST, or sales and use tax; customs import duty is the only indirect levy, and neither imports nor exports are subject to VAT/GST
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable; no VAT/GST/sales tax registration threshold exists. Customs duty registration and bond requirements apply only to importers licensed under RMI Customs and Tariff regulations.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Not applicable; no real-time fiscal clearance mandate, e-invoicing API, or digital stamping requirement. Customs export/import filings are processed electronically through ASYCUDA World, but no invoice clearance or tax-stamping applies to exports.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable because the Marshall Islands imposes no VAT, GST, or sales tax. There is no statutory 0% export VAT rate to claim, and no export tax, offshore services tax, or consumption tax is levied on non-resident business corporations exporting medical imaging equipment.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Marshall Islands Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World trade processing system) evidencing physical departure of the goods from RMI customs territory
Bill of Lading, Sea Waybill, or Air Waybill consigned to the foreign purchaser
Commercial invoice and packing list describing the Color Doppler Ultrasound Console, harmonized system code, serial numbers, and export value
Inward remittance evidence, including SWIFT MT103 confirmation or bank credit statement, supporting receipt of export proceeds in foreign currency
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: As zero-rating does not exist, there are no export VAT refunds or clawback penalties. However, RICA and RMI Customs may audit export declarations for customs/franchise tax compliance; false declarations, forged shipping documents, or misclassified medical device exports may attract fines up to USD 50,000, penalty assessments up to 200% of undeclared value, forfeiture of goods, and criminal liability for willful fraud. Additionally, export proceeds received after the 180-day best-practice deadline may trigger exchange-control or regulatory reporting scrutiny, though RMI maintains no formal foreign exchange control regime.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance & Banking, Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI). The RMI maintains no central bank, no currency-issuing authority, and no domestic monetary policy framework. The U.S. dollar is the sole legal tender under the Compact of Free Association, making the U.S. Federal Reserve and the U.S. correspondent banking network the de facto monetary anchor. Licensing, AML/CFT supervision, and financial-market conduct regulation are administered by the Banking Commissioner and the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) under the Banking Act 1991 and the AML/CFT Regulations 2004, as amended.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full de jure and de facto convertibility in both capital and current accounts. The RMI imposes no exchange controls, no foreign-investment approval, no surrender requirements, and no repatriation restrictions on dividends, loan repayments, trade proceeds, or capital injections. Profit remittance is subject only to RMI income-tax compliance: the ordinary corporate tax rate is 3% on RMI-source income, while a non-resident Business Corporation (BC) earning no RMI-source income qualifies for statutory exemption; no central-bank permit or tax clearance is required. Practical convertibility, however, is constrained by the absence of a local interbank FX market and by correspondent-bank de-risking pressure arising from RMI's status on the FATF list of jurisdictions under increased monitoring (grey list) and its inclusion on the EU Code of Conduct Group non-cooperative list. Funds are effectively cleared in USD through U.S. correspondents, and non-USD settlements require offshore banks.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. The RMI imposes no statutory timeline, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no requirement to surrender export proceeds to the RMI government or any authorized dealer. Export earnings may be retained offshore in any currency; for an ISIC 3250 medical-device exporter with USD functional currency, receipts are typically held in USD. The only obligations are documentary retention: commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, LC documents, and related bank records must be preserved for not less than five years for tax and AML audit purposes.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (USD demand deposit) and Capital Escrow Account pending Business License endorsement
Operational Account (USD) with segregated escrow sub-ledger for trade settlements

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Reputable offshore digital EMIs (Airwallex, Mercury, Wise Business, Payoneer, Currencycloud) routinely decline RMI-registered non-resident Business Corporations because RMI is on the FATF grey list and the EU non-cooperative tax list. The lack of a local fit-and-proper licensing nexus, the entity's tax-exempt shell profile, and the zero-minimum-capital structure compound the risk. EMIs that accept RMI entities impose strict conditions: a second operational license or branch in Singapore/Hong Kong/UK, a minimum of 12 months of audited trading history, and a U.S.-bank reference. The greenfield entity cannot satisfy these conditions; reliance should be placed on the two domestic banks with U.S. correspondent clearance for at least the first 18 months of operation.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory in practice. The RMI Banking Act 1991 and the AML/CFT Regulations 2004, as amended, require full customer due diligence, and grey-list enhanced measures make strict EDD universal across licensed banks. At least one director or an authorized signatory must physically attend a branch interview in Majuro or Ebeye, or be visited by a bank officer at a U.S. post, before account opening is approved. Remote opening is permitted only for established international banking relationships with a satisfactory U.S. bank reference letter; even in that case, the bank requires a video conference interview, notarized and apostilled corporate documents, certified passport copies, and a board resolution appointing the signatories. A corporate service provider may escort the client but cannot substitute for the personal appearance requirement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: RMI Business Corporation registered as a non-resident, tax-exempt entity with zero minimum capital and no demonstrated local substance; immediate shell-company classification in the bank's AML scoring engine.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized Certificate of Good Standing and Certificate of Incumbency from the RMI Registrar; executed RMI Business License; letter of comfort from the registered agent confirming no bearer shares in circulation; local office lease in Majuro or an executed registered-office agreement; curriculum vitae and identification of a resident compliance officer or local director; business plan including ISO 13485 and FDA 510(k) or CE registration evidence establishing a genuine medical-device export operation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO resident in a high-risk or sanctions-adjacent jurisdiction (e.g., Hong Kong, UAE, mainland China) with concentrated single-shareholder ownership.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full UBO chart with exact percentage interests; notarized bank statements and wealth documents for each shareholder demonstrating lawful source of funds; statutory declaration of source of wealth; parent company registration documents and board resolutions, if applicable; professional introduction letters from licensed lawyers or accountants with verifiable credentials; tax residence evidence via CRS/GIIN registration or equivalent.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Purpose-of-account mismatch: declared activity of manufacturing portable phased-array ultrasound consoles does not align with RMI's jurisdiction profile because no local factory or RMI import/export trade license is demonstrable.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: End-to-end transaction narrative: purchase orders from FDA or CE-cleared medical distributors; pro-forma invoices and supply agreements with component manufacturers in Shenzhen, Suzhou, or Taiwan; bill-of-lading trail; quality certificates (ISO 13485, IEC 60601-2-37 for ultrasound equipment); contract-manufacturing agreement; shipment forecast; RMI Ministry of Health import permit if any component enters RMI, or proof that all goods ship directly from the contract manufacturer to the final destination.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital injection originating from a third country inconsistent with the shareholder's country of residence, or payments that do not match the stated commercial flow.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Pre-opening ledger including notarized share subscription agreement; share allotment board resolution; SWIFT confirmation of the originator account and settlement value date; funding-flow matrix mapping sender account, sending bank, intermediate beneficiary bank, and final RMI account; legal opinion letter from engagement counsel explaining the transaction rationale and confirming the absence of structuring or layering.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Because the RMI has no inward FDI approval, no exchange-control license, and no capital-account registration requirement, equity injection is executed as a plain USD wire from the shareholder's reputable banking provider directly to the RMI operating account via SWIFT MT103. Optimal routing: the sending bank should be a U.S., Singapore, or Hong Kong licensed institution (e.g., HSBC, Standard Chartered, JPMorgan, or Bank of Hawaii) and the wire must contain (i) tag 50K with shareholder legal name and account number; (ii) tag 59 with the full MH_BC corporate name; and (iii) tag 70/reference field reading 'Equity subscription per Business Corporations Act 1990 - MH_BC share issue' to avoid mischaracterization as trade credit or loan. The receiving RMI bank will require the notarized board resolution authorizing the allotment, the subscription agreement, and the register of members. Inbound amounts above USD 250,000 trigger a 5 to 10 business-day enhanced due-diligence hold pending UBO identity verification. Funds must arrive exclusively through banking channels; RMI banks reject deposits originating from unlicensed money transmitters, casinos, or virtual-currency exchanges.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Two compliant clearing rails are available for the color-Doppler ultrasound console supply chain: (1) Direct wire - SWIFT MT103 for component purchases under USD 50,000, settled in USD same-day via U.S. correspondent banks (FEDWIRE/CHIPS), with the invoice number and Incoterms 2020 (EXW or FOB) referenced in tag 70. (2) Documentary credit - an irrevocable UCP600-compliant commercial letter of credit issued by the RMI bank's U.S. correspondent in favor of the Asian component supplier, with the MH_BC as applicant. Given the thin correspondent network, the LC tenor should be limited to 30 to 60 days sight or deferred payment, with the document package comprising the original commercial invoice, full set of bills of lading, packing list, inspection certificate, and any required export registration. Export sales may be settled by LC advised or confirmed through the buyer's bank (commonly HSBC, BNP Paribas, or MUFG) and will credit the RMI account only after U.S. correspondent clearing. All outbound disbursements must include the RMI Business License number and a precise commercial narrative in the payment details to pass OFAC and BIS sanctions screening without exception.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/CNY deliverable outright forwards, 1 to 6 month tenor, executed through a licensed Hong Kong or Singapore bank where the MH_BC maintains an offshore operating account
USD/CNY non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) arranged by a Singapore authorized broker to hedge RMB-denominated component costs without physical CNY settlement
EUR/USD plain-vanilla FX forwards or FX swaps to hedge European distributor revenue against the USD functional currency
USD/CNY and EUR/USD zero-cost collars (range forwards) approved by the Board of Directors as a conservative risk-reduction instrument

Cross-currency interest rate swaps (CCIRS) for project-financing-linked deferred receivables in EUR or CNY, executed under an ISDA Master Agreement governed by English law, subject to an RMI legal opinion confirming the transaction is intra vires and requires no approval from the Banking Commissioner

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporation Report (statutory renewal of corporate registration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Majuro) — filed via the licensed Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary-based renewal: due on or before the last day of the month of the incorporation anniversary each year; no statutory grace period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: US$500 late-filing penalty; administrative dissolution or cancellation of the Certificate of Incorporation if arrears exceed 12 months; reinstatement requires payment of all back fees and penalties

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent and Registered Office Renewal (annual consent and address certification)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Marshall Islands Registered Agent holding the statutory registered office in Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Concurrent with the annual report anniversary date; agent consent re-certified annually
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Agent resignation after 60 days' written notice; administrative dissolution if a replacement agent is not appointed within 30 days thereafter

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Re-confirmation and UBO Register Update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered Agent maintaining the Beneficial Ownership Register under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act and Beneficial Ownership Rules (effective 2017)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually at the renewal date; within 30 calendar days after any share transfer, allotment, or change in ultimate beneficial ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Civil and criminal penalties up to US$10,000 per violation; director and shareholder personal liability; non-compliant entities risk agent termination and administrative strike-off

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Non-Dissolution (banking and documentary-credit support)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Issued on demand once the annual report is current; obtain at each Swift LC negotiation and annual KYC refresh
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Optional filing; absence of a current certificate blocks correspondent-bank compliance, documentary credit issuance, and TT wire trade-finance lines

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Non-Resident Tax and Foreign Investment License Status Monitoring (negative filing — no RMI income-tax return, gross-receipts tax, or FIBL obligation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: RMI Ministry of Finance — Revenue and Taxation (monitoring only; no filing imposed on non-resident Business Corporations)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Continuous; re-verified annually at renewal and upon any commencement of RMI-source activity
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Commencement of RMI-source business triggers 3% gross-receipts tax, a Foreign Investment Business License requirement, and RMI Social Security obligations, applied prospectively

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act for a non-resident Business Corporation; no revenue, asset, or capital threshold triggers a statutory audit. An independent audit arises only from lender or investor covenants, a shareholder resolution, or foreign parent-company consolidation rules.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: The Business Corporations Act requires honest and adequate books and records but prescribes no filing-level GAAP; IFRS or US GAAP is the accepted commercial standard for the holding entity's accounts. Financial statements are not filed with the Marshall Islands Registrar.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Shareholders must disclose ultimate beneficial owners at incorporation and re-confirm ownership annually at the renewal date; the Registered Agent maintains the Beneficial Ownership Register and must be notified of any transfer or control change within 30 days; bearer shares are prohibited; failure to update is an offence carrying penalties up to US$10,000.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Beneficial Ownership Register (maintained with the Registered Agent)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$800–US$2,500 per year (licensed Registered Agent, registered office, UBO register upkeep, and annual report transmission)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$2,500–US$8,000 per engagement (voluntary; only if required by lender, investor, or group consolidation policy)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Zero corporate income tax on all foreign-source income for non-resident business corporations; no income tax resident status; no value‑added tax; no capital gains tax; no stamp duty on share transfers. The only annual fiscal liabilities are statutory corporate registration fees, franchise tax (calculated on authorised capital), and business license fees where applicable. No tax holidays or investment tax credits are needed because the permanent tax rate is nil.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act — Annual Report and Franchise Tax Statement; filed through a licensed Registered Agent via the Marshall Islands Corporate Registry online portal (eRegistry) or paper submission to the Office of the Registrar of Corporations.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due no later than the last day of the calendar month in which the anniversary of incorporation falls.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact corporate name as shown in the Certificate of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert full legal name; no DBA or trade name unless separately registered as a foreign trade name.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Unique registration number assigned by the Registrar of Corporations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Obtain the number from prior Certificate of Incorporation or from the annual statement.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Item 3: Registered Agent and Registered Office in Marshall Islands
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and address of the licensed registered agent and physical location of the registered office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident corporations must maintain a registered agent; cannot use a P.O. Box as the registered office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of authorised shares, par value per share, and aggregate capital.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the share structure exactly as in the Articles; any increase requires prior amendment filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names and residential/business addresses of all directors, president, secretary, and treasurer.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors may be non-residents; addresses cannot be omitted. A minimum of one director is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Item 6: Foreign Principal Office / Business Address
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Principal place of business outside the Marshall Islands where books and records are kept.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This field supports the foreign-source income exemption claim; records must be available at the registered agent's address if demanded.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing and late franchise tax penalties: USD 50 initial late fee plus USD 10 per calendar month or fraction of a month until filed; failure to file for three consecutive years triggers administrative dissolution and loss of limited liability protection.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% on all distributions of dividends or liquidation proceeds to non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No comprehensive double taxation agreement (DTA) network exists. The US–Marshall Islands Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA) does not alter domestic withholding rates. A non-resident shareholder claiming a foreign tax credit in another jurisdiction must obtain a Certificate of Tax Domicile/Residency from the Marshall Islands Registrar or a licensed registered agent. Because no tax is withheld in the Republic of the Marshall Islands, no treaty relief application is required for domestic purposes.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding rate on royalties and interest paid to non-residents: 0%. There are no treaty rates; the zero rate is absolute under the Business Corporations Act.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No mandatory local file or master file threshold. The Marshall Islands imposes no corporate income tax and accordingly has no domestic transfer pricing documentation rules. Transactions with foreign related parties may be examined by a foreign tax authority, and the Marshall Islands entity should maintain contemporaneous records to support arm's length pricing if used in a foreign group's filing. Recommendation: prepare TP documentation when group revenue exceeds USD 10,000,000 to satisfy foreign parent reporting.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Economic Substance Regulations 2019 (as amended) apply to corporations carrying on 'relevant activities': banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, holding company, intellectual property, distribution and service centres. Manufacturing of portable phased-array medical diagnostic scanners (ISIC 3250) is not a relevant activity. However, if the company holds intellectual property assets or acts as a pure equity holding entity, it must satisfy the economic substance test by maintaining management and control, staff, and physical presence in the Marshall Islands, and file an annual economic substance notification.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / false declaration of foreign-source income
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Making false statements or submitting forged documentation to the Registrar or to foreign tax authorities to claim treaty benefits or exemption, or deliberately structuring transactions to avoid a foreign tax obligation while misrepresenting the Marshall Islands as the source of income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Marshall Islands Criminal Code and the Business Corporations Act: fines up to USD 25,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years, plus civil penalties equal to understated amounts if applied by a foreign jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly authorise false filings may be held personally liable for restitution and subject to travel bans and custodial sentences; the corporate veil may be pierced for fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Engaging in a relevant activity (notably holding IP or financing) without maintaining defined presence, employees, and expenditures in the Marshall Islands, or failing to file the annual economic substance return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil penalty of USD 10,000 for the initial non-compliance year and USD 100,000 for each subsequent year; the Registrar may also require striking-off or dissolution of the company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors of a non-compliant entity may be fined USD 5,000 individually and disqualified from acting as a director in the Marshall Islands for up to 5 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Marshall Islands bank account or nominee director/shareholder arrangements to launder proceeds connected to procurement fraud, corruption, or bribery related to medical equipment supply contracts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Marshall Islands Proceeds of Crime Act: fines up to USD 200,000 and imprisonment up to 10 years; assets traceable to the offence are subject to confiscation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who are involved in or wilfully blind to money laundering face criminal liability, personal financial restitution orders, and surrender/revocation of passports (travel bans).

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to maintain beneficial ownership information
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Omission or inaccurate recording of ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) in the Registered Agent's register, or failure to update changes within 30 days.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fine of USD 5,000 per offence; continued non-compliance can result in criminal penalties up to USD 20,000 and 2 years' imprisonment for the signatory.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally liable for the administrative fine unless they can prove reliance on a licensed agent; aggravated instances lead to personal liability for criminal penalties.
